about: WP-21: every third-party asset RUNSHIFT plans to use, with the KitModel (src/render/types.ts) or role it fills. Read by tools/assets/fetch-polypizza.mjs (downloads the poly.pizza models) and snapshot.mjs (licence evidence), then by WP-22 (build-world), WP-24 (build-characters) and WP-52 (credits). Title, creator and licence were read from the live pages on the date in `checked`; fetch-polypizza.mjs warns when the API or a page says otherwise. `alsoFor` lists further KitModels the same source can fill. Licences and attribution lines live in assets/CREDITS.md; the manual downloads are listed in asset-sources/README.md.

priorities.P0: needed for M2: a source for every KitModel in the world kit (WP-22 check-kit) and the placeholder characters (WP-24)
priorities.P1: a fallback or alternative for a P0 slot, or needed from M3 on (subway district, Blender step)

assets.title: Animated Platformer Character
assets.creator: Quaternius
assets.notes: Hero placeholder until the Tripo hero arrives (docs/TRIPO-ASSETS.md). Rigged and animated, 2348 tris; WP-24 maps its clips to ClipName.

assets.title: Ninja
assets.creator: Quaternius
assets.notes: Thief placeholder until the Tripo thief arrives. Rigged and animated, 5780 tris. Holds a katana in the preview: WP-24 hides it if it is a separate node and puts the gold sack in the hand.

assets.title: Gold Bag
assets.creator: Quaternius
assets.notes: Brown sack with gold coins on top. 3954 tris, heavy for a prop: simplify hard. Also parented to the thief's hand (WP-24). The Tripo gold-sack replaces it later.

assets.title: Coin
assets.creator: Quaternius
assets.notes: Gold coin with an embossed star, 206 tris. Drawn up to 256 times per frame: keep it small after simplification.

assets.title: Pickup Thunder
assets.creator: Quaternius
assets.notes: Yellow lightning bolt inside a ring, 228 tris. The Tripo pickup-multiplier may replace it.

assets.title: Magnet
assets.creator: Poly by Google
assets.notes: Red horseshoe magnet with silver tips, 776 tris. CC-BY: needs the in-game credits screen while it ships; the Tripo pickup-magnet replaces it and removes the credit.

assets.title: Hoverboard
assets.creator: SamPokemon
assets.notes: Flat black board with cyan trim, 332 tris; also the pickup-glide token. CC-BY: needs the in-game credits screen while it ships; the Tripo glide-board replaces it and removes the credit.

assets.title: Shield bubble
assets.creator: RUNSHIFT (code)
assets.notes: No free model fits: a fresnel sphere (WP-33) or the Tripo pickup-shield. Not credited.

assets.title: Traffic Barrier
assets.creator: Quaternius
assets.notes: Red-and-white striped board on A-frame legs, 364 tris: fits barrierLow (w 1.8, y 0-1.0, d 0.4, jump).

assets.title: Scaffolding
assets.creator: lakescorp
assets.notes: Not a scaffold tower: a long horizontal steel truss, 384 tris. Use it as the scaffolding beam on facades and as the overhead beam of barrier-high (y 1.05-2.2, slide), on two posts the bake adds.

assets.title: Dumpster
assets.creator: Quaternius

assets.title: Taxi
assets.creator: Quaternius

assets.title: High Speed Wagon

assets.title: Air Conditioner
assets.creator: Quaternius
assets.notes: Grey rooftop AC unit with a pipe, 946 tris; roofUnit w 1.6, y 0-1.0, d 1.2 (jump). Also the CC0 fallback for wall-vent.

assets.title: Traffic Cone

assets.title: Water Tower

assets.title: Street Light
assets.creator: Quaternius

assets.title: Wall pipe
assets.creator: RUNSHIFT (code)
